title: Hybrid inheritance in Java
answer: Hybrid inheritance means combining more than one inheritance pattern in the same design, such as hierarchical inheritance together with multiple interface inheritance. Java does not support multiple inheritance of classes, but a class can extend one superclass and implement multiple interfaces. AeroTopo has `Orthomosaic` and `Dem` extending `Product`, while `Product` implements both `Exportable` and `Identified`; this is a practical hybrid-style structure without multiple superclass inheritance.
